Review Text: It takes forever to load my tasks every morning, so slow.
Loading time is brutal when I first open the app.
Dashboard is sluggish, especially first thing in the morning.
The app used to be snappy but now it lags every time I switch projects.
I get a push every time someone edits a checkbox, so I muted the whole app.
Too many notifications, I honestly can't tell what's actually important anymore.
Wish I could only get notified for @mentions instead of every single change.
There's no way to turn off notifications for just one project specifically.
Got charged for the team plan but I'm the only user, no idea why.
Support took a week to explain why I was billed twice in one month.
Cancelled my subscription but still got charged the next month, very frustrating.
The billing page is confusing and I can't tell what exactly I'm paying for.
Would love if my deadlines just showed up in Google Calendar automatically.
Every other tool I use syncs with Outlook, this one doesn't and it's annoying.
No calendar integration is honestly a dealbreaker for our whole workflow.
Searched for a task I know I made months ago and got absolutely nothing back.
Archive search feels broken
Date: or maybe it just doesn't exist at all.
